title: The Bomb Has Been Planted
blurb: Forty seconds on the clock, and every heart rate in the server goes up at once. Counter-Strike's announcement is a masterclass in tension: the sentence itself is calm and administrative, and it means the round has entered its terminal phase whatever anybody had planned. Twenty-five years of clutches, defuses and one-second losses live inside it. The meme usage maps it onto any point of no return — the message sent, the oven left on, the decision made out loud in front of witnesses. From here, everything is consequences.
